newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Nov industrial orders edge up 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: German Nov industrial orders edge up 0.5 pct.

text.p: German industrial orders rose 0.5 percent in November on a seasonally adjusted basis, driven by solid gains in eastern Germany and domestic capital goods orders, the economics ministry said on Tuesday.
Orders resumed a modest uptrend in November after earlier weakness. In October the index climbed 2.7 percent, after a 3.3 percent fall in September.
Orders in east Germany rose 5.6 percent from the previous month, while in west Germany they were up 0.2 percent.
For the country as a whole, domestic capital goods orders jumped 4.1 percent. Foreign capital goods orders rose 0.3 percent in November.
Orders for consumer goods were unchanged in November, while intermediate goods orders fell 0.8 percent.
November orders were 3.6 percent higher than in the year-earlier month. In west Germany they rose 5.5 percent year-on-year, while in the east they were down 21.8 percent.
